# An excerpt of two board traces of a frame that starts from the old depth
# and stencil, for the frame builder's Z/S preload proof (src/mali/
# frame_preload_tests.rs): each run's second frame, the command-stream
# words of its draw and the raw memory of the buffer that holds its
# framebuffer descriptor and its pre-frame draws (pre frame 0, the colour;
# pre frame 1, depth and stencil: DCD, depth/stencil, shader program
# descriptor, resource table, attribute, attribute buffer, sampler, the two
# textures and their planes).
#
# Board: NanoPC-T6 (RK3588, Mali-G610, GPU_ID 0xa8670005), Armbian,
# Linux 6.18.55-current-rockchip64, panthor 1.5.0, Mesa 25.0.7-2+deb13u1.
# The program, 0dce654a8:tools/mali/board-ref/2026-10-19-preload-zs/preload_zs.c: a
# 64x64 RGBA8 FBO with a D24S8; frame 1 clears and draws red over columns
# 0-31 at depth 0.5 with stencil 1; glFinish; frame 2 draws green over the
# whole target without a clear, depth-tested (mode depth) or stencil-tested
# (mode stencil), or so after clearing the other plane (depth_sclear,
# stencil_zclear: Mesa preloads one plane); "not as predicted 0", rc 0, by
# tools/mali/mesa-board-ref.sh
# (PAN_MESA_DEBUG=linear,nocrc,dump,trace,sync):
#   mesa-depth: mesa-depth.pandecode sha256 9ed313b4f413e1c38f690d79f2977f1d571e526a8b7ba474a56047e546d8ae47
#   mesa-stencil: mesa-stencil.pandecode sha256 46bc1424aba88af5e78c4751294963c0dc7b8d0170390dad108f770ed83deb44
#   mesa-depth_sclear: mesa-depth_sclear.pandecode sha256 e53b06f696ee1ab0ed9b339011a2af33e6e6dd143551a9e0ba65e9b065ea47e7
#   mesa-stencil_zclear: mesa-stencil_zclear.pandecode sha256 6f61b5be9174133d0f2dcd7b54520d60ee197677aab83fa63f8ab7c17c7428c7
